description: This file defines the MessageMapperRegistry interface, which manages a collection of MessageMappers with a default fallback and provides methods to retrieve, validate, and check support for payload mappings.

classes.name: MessageMapperRegistry
classes.description: An interface defining methods for managing message mappers, providing a default mapper, retrieving mappers based on payload mappings, and validating payload mappings.

methods.name: getDefaultMapper
methods.description: Returns a mapper with the supposed role of a fallback mapping strategy.

methods.name: getMappers
methods.description: Returns the list of MessageMappers to use for the provided payload mapping.

methods.name: validatePayloadMapping
methods.description: Checks if the provided PayloadMapping can be resolved using this registry, throwing an exception if not.
